title: Fix: the restock that never lands
hints: New SKUs and shipments both work; only receiving more of a SKU the warehouse already has goes wrong. Follow the code path for that case and ask *which* `quantity` it adds to.

`StockItem item = w->items[i];` declares a new struct and copies the array element into it. `item.quantity += quantity` updates the copy, which disappears at `return`; the warehouse's own element never changes.
Work through a pointer to the element instead: `StockItem *item = &w->items[i];`, then `item->sku` and `item->quantity`.
